title: Choose the page structure
question: Same visual world (cyan, ink, yellow, Barlow). Pick how 'Eight ways work gets stuck' is composed, or re-roll.

options.label: Everything comes back to you
options.thesis: A figure with you at the centre and eight routes that all return to your desk; each route opens its pattern.
options.viewport: Cyan field: headline and booking left; right, a square hub figure, 'You' at centre, eight labelled spokes curving back in.
options.risk: A centre-and-spokes figure can read as a generic org chart unless the returning paths are drawn with intent.

options.label: The report, annotated
options.thesis: Open on a synthetic Walkthrough report page whose margin notes name the patterns, proving how the labels get used before explaining them.
options.viewport: Cyan field: headline left; right, the square folded report with three pattern labels pinned in its margin, labelled as an illustration.
options.risk: Previews the sample report you haven't written yet, and a synthetic report could be mistaken for a real client's.

options.label: The field guide ledger
options.thesis: A compact index of all eight up front, then each pattern as a full editorial spread: name and definition left, scene and signals right.
options.viewport: Cyan field: headline and intro left; right, a ruled numbered index of the eight names linking to their anchors.
options.risk: The most familiar arrangement; the figure has less room to be a signature moment.
